services.name: Rental Spaces
services.desc: The Platinum Ballroom offers a seamless blend of character and contemporary elegance. This open, airy space features beautiful columns, a unique accent wall, and subtle gold accents with recessed lighting all throughout. It’s the perfect neutral canvas waiting to be transformed for your unforgettable occasion. This spacious, open floor plan accommodates a seated event of up to 260 guests. The Gold Suite includes a private bathroom, dressing and makeup table, flatscreen TV, mini fridge, and plush seating. This lounge space is included with all full-day rentals at Suite Sixty.
